51:t_1:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[...Measuring brainwaves. Basal rhythm normal.]

51:t_1:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Awakening of Ensign $$レド$$ confirmed. Resuscitation successful.]

51:t_1:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Per emergency program, your vital functions were preserved through artificial hibernation.]

51:t_1:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Elapsed time: 266,815 minutes. This unit also froze all systems, and rebooted 1,451 minutes ago.]

51:t_1:10.en:
$$レド$$
[The $$時空震動|lc$$ that struck during the battle with the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$... And half a year has passed since then...]

51:t_1:11.en:
$$レド$$
[So we've been asleep all this time...!]

51:t_1:12.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The situation requires the pilot's judgment. Therefore, your awakening process was executed.]

51:t_1:18.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...So this is the treasure $$ベローズ$$ and $$ガロード$$ salvaged. So what the heck is this thing, anyway?」

51:t_1:19.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「If I knew that, I wouldn't be struggling. Forget peeling off the casing to look inside, I can't even put a scratch on it.」

51:t_1:20.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「No idea how they put the thing together.」

51:t_1:21.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Quit being stubborn. You could just get help from $$ガロード$$ or those $c people, or whatever they're called.」

51:t_1:22.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Shut up, $$ベローズ$$! This is my treasure. I'm not letting anyone lay a finger on it!」

51:t_1:23.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...All I need is for you to pay the agreed amount. Whether it's usable or not is none of my business.」

51:t_1:24.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You're the one who told me to pick up anything at all.」

51:t_1:30.en:
$$レド$$
[And the language they're speaking... It's awfully hard to make out.]

51:t_1:31.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Judged to be some form of ancient language.]

51:t_1:32.en:
$$レド$$
[They're not the $$人類銀河同盟$$... An unaffiliated drifting tribe, then...]

51:t_1:33.en:
$$レド$$
[They look like they've never even seen a $$マシンキャリバー$$.]

51:t_1:34.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Intent to damage this unit is observed, but means of carrying it out appear to be lacking. Group inferred to be of an extremely low level of civilization.]

51:t_1:35.en:
$$レド$$
[Did you wake me up to have me judge this situation?]

51:t_1:36.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Data insufficient for situational analysis. However, units of the same lineage as $$人類銀河同盟$$ allied units are confirmed in this group.]

51:t_1:37.en:
$$レド$$
[$$シリウス$$'s...? Or are they the ones who joined the fighting recently?]

51:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
[No... I can just confirm that directly. First, tell me our current location.]

51:t_1:39.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Identifying coordinates is impossible. The measurement reference point has been lost.]

51:t_1:41.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Conjecture. After being caught up in the attack by the $$時空震動|lc$$, this unit...]

51:t_1:42.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[...is thought to have synchronized with normal space at randomly selected coordinates.]

51:t_1:44.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[While transmitting a distress signal, this unit continued your artificial hibernation, but the situation is shifting in a direction that cannot be passively observed.]

51:t_1:45.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Please consider a course of action.]

51:t_1:46.en:
$$レド$$
[Easier said than done... From what I can see they seem to be kin of humanity, but I can't decide anything until I know who they really are.]

51:t_1:47.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Reporting external conditions. Gravity is 1 G. The main components of the atmosphere are nitrogen, oxygen, and carbon dioxide. An ideal ratio for survival.]

51:t_1:48.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Other trace components exist, but no harmful substances were detected.]

51:t_1:49.en:
$$レド$$
[That doesn't mean I can just climb out of the cockpit in this situation.]

51:t_1:50.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The surrounding bulkhead structure is expected to be extremely fragile. Even at this unit's current output, breaking through it to escape is possible.]

51:t_1:51.en:
$$レド$$
[No good. If I move carelessly, I'll hurt the people outside.]

51:t_1:52.en:
$$レド$$
[Anyway, I'll let them do what they like until they get bored. Once the people are gone, we move.]

51:t_1:57.en: ～ $$ガルガンティア船団$$, Fleet Commander's Room ～

51:t_1:58.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...I understand your circumstances.」

51:t_1:59.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「As thanks for helping the people of our fleet, I promise you every cooperation possible.」

51:t_1:60.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Thank you very much, Fleet Commander $$フェアロック$$.」

51:t_1:61.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There are a few things I would like to ask. Would that be all right?」

51:t_1:62.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「If it's something I can answer.」

51:t_1:63.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》 we were told about had no fleet society like this one.」

51:t_1:64.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Were you and this green sea transferred here by the 《$$新世時空震動$$》?」

51:t_1:65.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...Unfortunately, my knowledge will not let me give you a satisfactory answer to that question. So I will tell you only what I have seen.」

51:t_1:66.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...About a year ago, one day... we were caught up in a strange storm unlike any we had ever experienced.」

51:t_1:67.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「After it passed, we noticed that our surroundings had subtly changed from the scenery we were used to.」

51:t_1:69.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「As for this phenomenon of transference, I have heard most of it from $$ガロード$$.」

51:t_1:70.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Judging from the circumstances before and after, we may safely say that we and this sea came from another world.」

51:t_1:72.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「But whatever kind of world this is, our way of life does not change.」

51:t_1:73.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「In this sea we gather together, form a fleet, and travel with the currents and the wind...」

51:t_1:74.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「We live with the sea, spin new life, and then die. That is all.」

51:t_1:75.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This world has continents, too. Do you not go ashore?」

51:t_1:76.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「We have lived on the sea since our forefathers' time. We have no intention of changing that now.」

51:t_1:77.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「We are the people of the $$残されの海$$... Those who live with this sea.」

51:t_1:78.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Even though the world has changed, to be bound by such things...」

51:t_1:79.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Please do not misunderstand. We are content with this life.」

51:t_1:80.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I know there are superior civilizations in other regions, like that machine of $$ガロード$$'s.」

51:t_1:81.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Living with our backs turned to all of that, we are truly the people of the $$残されの海$$, I suppose.」

51:t_1:82.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Didn't the name $$残されの海$$ come into use after you arrived in this world?」

51:t_1:83.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「That name has been handed down since our forefathers' time. To us, the world is this sea.」

51:t_1:84.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「And wherever one goes, whatever one gains, human nature does not change.」

51:t_1:86.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「It is to live. Our fleet is doing nothing more than that.」

51:t_1:87.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I understand. ...Please forgive my rude remarks.」

51:t_1:88.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I'm not bothered. People have a hard time accepting what is different from themselves.」

51:t_1:89.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Our continuing this way of life may, in the end, be nothing more than a rejection of the new.」

51:t_1:90.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...I heard from $$ガロード$$. That the $$サイデリアル$$ have recently begun appearing in this $$残されの海$$ as well...」

51:t_1:91.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「They pay no attention to us. They seem to be interested only in the $$クジライカ$$.」

uncertain: Chamber/Ledo rows use 【...】 in Japanese; the checker rejects non-ASCII 【】 so they are written with ASCII square brackets [...].
Chamber speaker line: chose $$チェインバー#pilot$$ (speaker role); caption 57:t_1:3 uses #robot for the cockpit.
51:t_1:37 シリウス: rendered as $$シリウス$$'s...? (a person/group Ledo expects as allies); referent unverified, no earlier slice explains it.
Rank 少尉 = Ensign (matches existing 'Ensign' for リディ少尉).
翠の海 rendered 'this green sea' (no glossary entry for the phrase); 残されの海 uses its proposed token $$残されの海$$ in prose, including 残されの海の民 = 'people of the Left-Behind Sea'.
51:t_1:21 あの$cとかいう連中: 'those $c people, or whatever they're called'.
51:t_1:71 やはり、そうだったのですね = 'I thought so...'.
51:t_1:89 Fairlock's sentence read as: continuing this life may be nothing more than rejecting the new.
